scope: Legacy subgraph provider and ClickHouse outbox reporting

behavior.provider_failures: Raw provider and database exception details are replaced with a fixed Subgraph indexing failed summary containing only the exception class before status, ingestion audit, and log reporting.
behavior.outbox_failures: The indexer preserves OutboxEnqueueError and source rollback while using a fixed summary and suppressing raw cause text.
behavior.connection_free_projection: The demo/maintenance ClickHouse warning records only the exception class.

coverage: secret-bearing provider exception redacted from chain status, ingestion audit, and logs
outbox failure keeps its exception type, rolls back, and suppresses sensitive detail
connection-free ClickHouse warning omits provider exception text

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; a fake connection and mocked provider boundary were used

limitations: No subgraph or ClickHouse endpoint was contacted.
The legacy indexer remains outside the isolated EAS worker path; this change does not establish provider parity or recovery completeness.
